summary: Comprehensive testing of Organization-Level Task Approval Workflows feature. All backend API tests pass (27/27). Frontend UI testing confirms workflow management in System Settings and read-only view in Project Settings are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed route ordering bug in workflow_router.py - /pending route was being matched by /{workflow_id} pattern. Moved /pending before dynamic routes.
Added missing workflow/approval permissions to frontend Permission enum in auth.js
seed_data_creation: Test workflows and tasks created during testing are cleaned up automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Organization-level workflow feature is fully functional. Key test file: /app/backend/tests/test_org_workflows.py covers all CRUD operations, rule management, project assignment, workflow resolution, and approval flow. The frontend WorkflowSettings component is integrated into System Settings (SettingsPage.jsx) and ProjectWorkflowView shows read-only workflow info in project settings.

backend_api: PUT /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/projects - Assign projects to selective workflow
frontend_ui: WorkflowSettings in System Settings - Create/Edit/Delete workflows
ProjectWorkflowView in Project Settings - Read-only view
Task status change with approval lock icon
Approval pending banner with Approve/Reject buttons

workflow_resolution_logic: Global workflows take priority over selective workflows. When checking for applicable workflow: 1) First check for active global workflow, 2) If none, check for selective workflow assigned to the project
